user_data: #!/bin/bash    # NAT configuration from the AWS NAT instance guide, applied at first boot.    set -euo pipefail    EGRESS_CIDR="${var.egress_subnet_cidr}"    # Package repositories are reachable only after the Elastic IP is    # associated, so retry for up to ten minutes.    for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do      if dnf -y install iptables-services; then        break      fi      sleep 10    done    cat > /etc/sysctl.d/90-nat-forwarding.conf <<'CONF'    net.ipv4.ip_forward=1    CONF    sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/90-nat-forwarding.conf    IFACE="$(ip -o -4 route show to default | awk '{print $5}' | head -n 1)"    systemctl enable --now iptables    iptables -t nat -F POSTROUTING    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o "$IFACE" -s "$EGRESS_CIDR" -j MASQUERADE    iptables -F FORWARD    iptables -P FORWARD DROP    iptables -A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT    iptables -A FORWARD -i "$IFACE" -s "$EGRESS_CIDR" -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT    service iptables save

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS Lambda function is configured to validate code-signing

check_result.suppress_comment: No code signing configuration yet; images are immutable, scanned on push and deployed by digest. Signing needs a signing profile and pipeline (INFRA-005).

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that AWS Lambda function is configured for a Dead Letter Queue(DLQ)

check_result.suppress_comment: No function DLQ; the functions are invoked synchronously (HTTP API, SQS event source mappings) and failed SQS messages go to the queue DLQs.

skipped_checks.check_name: Check encryption settings for Lambda environmental variable

check_result.suppress_comment: The api, general and executor environments hold only non-secret settings (secret ARNs, never values). The parser environment holds one credential, its restricted DATABASE_URL, only while parser_database_url_enabled is true, by the accepted ADR-018 fallback (the parser has no route to Secrets Manager; the value is also in Terraform state). Lambda's default encryption; no customer managed KMS key.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that AWS Lambda function is configured for function-level concurrent execution limit

check_result.suppress_comment: No reserved concurrency; SQS event sources cap concurrency at 2 and the HTTP API is throttled, and reserving concurrency is not possible on accounts with the reduced new-account concurrency quota.

skipped_checks.check_name: X-Ray tracing is enabled for Lambda

check_result.suppress_comment: X-Ray tracing is off; ADR-011 structured tracing is application-level and X-Ray adds per-trace charges.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure API GatewayV2 routes specify an authorization type

check_result.suppress_comment: No API Gateway authorizer: guest routes are anonymous by design (ADR-008) and the API function validates Cognito access tokens for owner routes (auth.py).

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that CloudWatch Log Group is encrypted by KMS

check_result.suppress_comment: Access logs use CloudWatch Logs default encryption; no customer managed KMS key.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure CloudWatch log groups retains logs for at least 1 year

check_result.suppress_comment: Retention is deliberately short (api_log_retention_days, default 14) to control storage cost.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure CloudFront distribution has Access Logging enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: No CloudFront access logging in this stage to avoid log storage; revisit in HARD-001.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure CloudFront distributions should have origin failover configured

check_result.suppress_comment: No origin failover; a single private S3 origin in one Region (ADR-017).

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS CloudFront web distribution has geo restriction enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: No geo restriction; the public demo is intended to be reachable worldwide.

skipped_checks.check_name: Verify CloudFront Distribution Viewer Certificate is using TLS v1.2 or higher

check_result.suppress_comment: The default CloudFront certificate is used (no custom domain or ACM in this stage), which does not allow setting the minimum TLS version.

skipped_checks.check_name: CloudFront Distribution should have WAF enabled

check_result.suppress_comment: No WAF in this stage (excluded by scope and cost); the origin is read-only static content behind OAC.

skipped_checks.check_name: Ensure that ECR repositories are encrypted using KMS

check_result.suppress_comment: AES256 (AWS-owned key) encryption is deliberate; no customer managed KMS key with a monthly charge (ADR-017 cost target).

check_result.suppress_comment: Retention is deliberately short (log_retention_days, default 14) to control storage cost; a one-year retention is not required for this portfolio deployment.
